description: The small low fire fronts burn gently in place. Their irregular upper contours slowly grow and recede, short rounded tips separate and merge softly in staggered phases. Fire stays low and spread across the tile, with modest outward motion at two edges. The rock tile, cracks, camera and fire roots remain perfectly motionless. Only the soft flame contours and internal orange flow move, never the entire shape. Constant warm light, no flashes, sparks, smoke, tall jets, cones or uniform pulses. Return naturally to the starting low flame shape.
subject_description: a fixed isometric stone floor tile covered with painterly orange ground fire and several broad short low flame fronts
initial_pose: steady low burning across the tile, short broad tongues at scattered positions
